articles.summary: New initiative designed to help farmers share in the value created through qualifying farming practices and evolving biofuels policy Green Plains today announced the launch of Farm Forward, a new initiative designed to turn policy innovation into farmer opportunity. Recent biofuels policy developments have created new opportunities to recognize qualifying farming practices and the role they play in producing lower carbon intensity feedstocks. Farm Forward provides a framework for participating farmers to share in the value created through regenerative agriculture practices while supporting and strengthening rural communities. Participating growers may be eligible to earn premiums ranging from $0.05 to $0.25 per qualifying bushel, with five performance bands designed to create multiple opportunities to maximize value returned to producers. “Farmers should have the opportunity to share in the value they help create,” said Chris Osowski, President and Chief Executive Officer of Green
articles.title: Green Plains Introduces Farm Forward to Turn Policy Innovation into Farmer Opportunity

articles.summary: Milestone reflects nearly two decades of safe operations, agricultural partnership, and economic impact in Northwest Iowa Green Plains Inc. (NASDAQ: GPRE) today announced that its facility in Superior, Iowa, has produced its one-billionth gallon of ethanol, marking a significant milestone in the facility's nearly two decades of operation. Commissioned in 2008, the facility was one of the first production assets in the Green Plains fleet and remains an important economic driver for Dickinson County and the surrounding region. Today, the facility employs nearly 50 team members and supports a network of local farmers, grain haulers, contractors, and agribusiness partners throughout Northwest Iowa and Southwest Minnesota. “Producing one billion gallons of ethanol is a meaningful accomplishment that represents nearly two decades of consistent execution," said Chris Osowski, President and Chief Executive Officer of Green Plains. articles.title: Green Plains Facility in Superior, Iowa, Marks One Billion Gallons of Ethanol Production

articles.summary: Agreement increases visibility into cash generation through the transfer of up to $325 million of 45Z credits generated in 2026, providing flexibility to strengthen the balance sheet and reinvest in high-return opportunities Green Plains Inc. (NASDAQ: GPRE) today announced an agreement for the transfer of Clean Fuel Production Tax Credits, also known as 45Z tax credits, generated across Green Plains’ operating facilities, all of which are expected to qualify under the program. The agreement provides for the transfer of a minimum of $250 million of 45Z credits expected to be generated in 2026, and the buyers will purchase additional credits up to a total of $325 million, with an option to purchase an additional $30 million, subject to their generation and availability. articles.title: Green Plains Enters into Agreement to Monetize 2026 45Z Clean Fuel Production Tax Credits
